server.title: VAT Validator MCP
server.description: Validate EU, UK, AU VAT numbers for AI agents. EU ViDA e-invoicing compliance.

serverInfo.name: vat-validator-mcp
serverInfo.description: Every B2B payment workflow built on Stripe MPP, Alipay AI Pay, or Shopify UCP has a moment where the agent must validate a supplier VAT number before authorising transfer. This server answers that question in one call -- validating against live EU VIES and AU ABR government registries and returning a machine-ready PROCEED / VERIFY_MANUALLY / HOLD verdict. Used before any invoice approval or payment rail invocation.
